same_turn_behavior: When a qualifying state change is confirmed, emit the event before finishing the assistant response.
deduplication: Fetch state.json before creating a new project/task; update an existing matching item when possible. Event ids are idempotent.
concurrency: Each chat writes a unique event file. The serialized GitHub Actions builder merges all unprocessed events into state.json.
privacy: Store high-level task/status metadata only. Never store tokens, passwords, bank details, identity numbers, medical records, or sensitive document contents.
